descriptive_A_C_only.reason: A and C are unpaired and time separated; descriptive differences cannot identify an exact causal or additive JPEG contribution
descriptive_A_C_only.CB_scope: C/B removes JPEG generation on both sides but still includes transport, presenter/Gst versus EGL, snapshot cadence, initialization and rendering differences

unpaired_A_C_descriptive_only.reason: A and C are unpaired and time separated; descriptive differences cannot identify an exact causal or additive JPEG contribution
unpaired_A_C_descriptive_only.CB_scope: C/B removes JPEG generation on both sides but still includes transport, presenter/Gst versus EGL, snapshot cadence, initialization and rendering differences

GPU_utilization: UNKNOWN: debugfs raw-unit calibration is not established; all-zero values during known GLES rendering do not mean0percent
measurement_scope: process families and unchanged common live UI/camera background in isolated mapped opaque test windows; not a production cutover
attribution_limit: A/B pipeline differs in JPEG, old fallback prewarm, queues and snapshot cadence. C/B matches absence of JPEG only; transport/presenter/Gst versus EGL and cadence still differ. A/C is unpaired and time-separated. No pure character algorithm or exact additive JPEG saving claim.
frame_statistics_scope: P95/P99/max cover the final239 handoff/swap intervals, roughly15s at16fps; achieved FPS covers the full60s. Net target frame deficit is a boundary-sensitive estimate (+/-1), not a count of per-slot dropped frames. A identity callback entry and B EGL swap are different software boundaries; neither is physical scanout.
cpu_signal_policy: All pair deltas negative and absolute mean greater than2x sample standard deviation; descriptive n4/n2 rule, not statistical significance or a universal prediction. Whole-board and renderer-family signals separate.

main.limitation: Same PID/config and sampled people/identity activity are necessary workload context, not proof of identical camera pixels. Mismatched pairs stay in all numeric summaries but cannot identify a same-workload whole-board effect.

noJPEG_control.limitation: Same PID/config and sampled people/identity activity are necessary workload context, not proof of identical camera pixels. Mismatched pairs stay in all numeric summaries but cannot identify a same-workload whole-board effect.

background_load_note: All runs retained. Case11 had people_count1 and active identity processing; case12 had people_count0 and no identity increments, changing the second control pair workload. Higher whole-boardCPU persisted in case12, so neither total difference is a pure renderer effect. Main8 cases all had people_count0 and no identity increments.
